raw_namespace_note: XML_Parser creates xml_parser_create() without a namespace separator: names stay raw qualified names and xmlns/xmlns:* (including xmlns="") are ordinary attributes. With the package default $folding = true every name is upper-cased; the harness sets the documented property to false. Not repaired by the harness.
wrapper_assessment: XML_Parser drives the parse itself (creates and configures the ext/xml parser, binds the handler object, feeds the bytes and frees the parser), so it is a libxml2-family SAX package path rather than a mapping of an already parsed tree. Its interpreted PHP adds no input-dependent native tuples: every tuple that differs between the controls also differs under a bare xml_parser_create/xml_parse baseline with the same handler object.
shared_family: libxml2 push parser via PHP ext/xml (compat.c), shared with the standard xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse path and the other libxml2 package paths
